title: canvas.json: the versions of a screen to compare, and the screen sizes to show them at
$comment: The head of a design-better unit. `widths` lists the sizes most used first: the page opens on the first. Each version has a label and exactly one of `file` (an HTML file in the unit's folder, relative to it) or `address` (an http(s) address the user's browser can reach).

question.description: what the user decides, shown under the heading; empty when there is none

widths.description: screen sizes in pixels, WIDTH or WIDTHxHEIGHT, such as 375 or 1280x800; a height is 800 for a width of 768 or more, otherwise 700

file.description: an HTML file in the unit's folder, relative to it

address.description: an http(s) address, loaded when the page is viewed
